features.ios: Website — no wrapper change. Arrives on the next deploy.
features.name: Whole-web search (top 3 + count)
features.summary: Search the whole web, not one store. Says how many results were found, shows the top three, more by voice or scrolling. 5-minute repeat cache, first results spoken within ~15 seconds.

features.ios: Website — no wrapper change. Wrapper adds the audio session and background audio (WebView.swift, Info.plist).
features.name: Live voice conversation (speech-to-speech)
features.summary: She listens, understands, talks back like a person, remembers the conversation. OpenAI Realtime on the website; Android uses on-phone listening plus the server for understanding.

features.ios: Website — the wrapper uses the website's live voice; on-device listening is not in the website yet.
features.name: On-device listening + Whisper fallback
features.summary: The phone itself hears the words (free, private, no key used). Whisper on the phone is the fallback for languages the built-in hearing does not cover. Built on Android; the website still uses the live voice call.

features.ios: Website — no wrapper change. Wrapper grants the camera.
features.name: Barcode scan
features.summary: Camera reads the barcode; lookup is Open Food Facts, then UPCitemdb, then one whole-web search for the digits. Unknown barcodes are read aloud digit by digit and can be taught.

features.ios: Website — no wrapper change. Wrapper grants the camera.
features.name: Camera 'what is this?'
features.summary: Point the camera, she describes what she sees. Never guesses a brand or a price; if a barcode is in the picture she uses that instead.

features.name: Stores near you + location choice
features.summary: 'Near me' uses the saved place; 'I'm looking to buy in England' (or anywhere) searches in that country instead. If no place is said, the saved location is used.

features.name: Voice shopping list, Buy again, reorder
features.summary: Add things by voice, buy again by voice, reorder shortcuts. Lists live on the phone.

features.name: Watchlist, price-drop alerts, daily roundup
features.summary: Watch an item and hear when its price drops; a spoken daily roundup of drops on the list.

features.name: Favorite stores first + spoken deals summary
features.summary: Favorite stores are checked first in every search; a spoken deals summary across favorite stores.

features.name: Natural-language commands in 50 languages
features.summary: Say what you want in any of the 50 languages; the server understands it. Confirms before buy, pay, or delete.

features.name: Voice feedback ('helpful / not helpful')
features.summary: Say whether a result was helpful. Stored on the phone only.

features.name: Conversation spine ('the second one', 'the cheaper one')
features.summary: Follow-ups work: 'the second one', 'the cheaper one', 'buy that one'.

features.ios: Wrapper change: WebView.swift (picture-in-picture media playback, audio-session interruption bridging) and Info.plist (audio background mode). Web behaviour arrives on deploy.
features.name: Mini floating window + phone-call pause
features.summary: The app keeps talking in a small floating window while other apps are used, and pauses on an incoming phone call, then resumes where it left off. On the iPhone web version a true floating window over other apps is not possible — background audio is the mechanism.

features.name: Reviews read aloud
features.summary: Short good-and-bad summary of what buyers say. Never invents a review; says plainly when only a rating and count are known.

features.name: Compare by voice
features.summary: 'Compare the first one and the second one' — a short, fair spoken comparison (price, rating, key differences).

features.name: Coupons
features.summary: Finds a deal code and reads it out. A code is only ever read when it literally appears in the results — never invented — and may not work at checkout.

features.ios: Website — no wrapper change. The wrapper already opens tel: links in the Phone app.
features.name: Call the store by voice
features.summary: 'Call Walmart' dials the store's real number. Stores with no public number show none — never a made-up one.

features.name: Price history
features.summary: Was it cheaper before? Only from prices the app has actually seen — never guessed.

features.name: Tell me about the store
features.summary: Nearest location, how many locations, hours, phone, delivery; online-only stores are named online-only, never given a made-up address. Unknown stays unknown.

features.name: Remember clothing sizes
features.summary: Men's sizes first, on the phone only, changeable by voice.

features.name: Return windows read aloud
features.summary: How long a store takes returns, from a verified list; unknown stays unknown.

features.name: Back-in-stock alerts
features.summary: Watch an item that is out of stock and hear when it comes back. On the web there is no push notification — the alert is spoken at the next check or in the daily roundup.

features.name: Shared pure memory
features.summary: One shared entry per item (name, brand, barcode, price + history, where to buy, aisle/shelf, reviews summary, allergens). Photos are never stored or shared, only the facts they revealed. Nothing leaves a phone automatically; a taught fact is shared only after that user confirms. DRIFT: the website uses /api/shop/memory and /api/shop/memory/share; Android calls /api/memory/lookup and /api/memory/teach, which the server does not have yet — see api-contract.json.

features.ios: Website — no wrapper change. The owner page lives in the website's /admin, reached from the wrapper.
features.name: Owner usage page
features.summary: Visitors, searches, barcode scans per day, new vs returning, most-searched, most-tapped buy, language and platform — counts only, no names, voice-readable ('Hear the numbers'), behind the owner PIN.

features.name: Report-a-mistake / teaching loop
features.summary: Report a wrong result; the correction is saved on that phone and becomes a test case. A rule is never applied without the owner's yes/no.

features.name: Delivery times read aloud
features.summary: Delivery time and cost read verbatim from the store's own page, never guessed; 'fastest delivery' searches with delivery first.

note: One row per feature. 'website' paths are inside ain-shop-shared/web/. 'android' paths are inside ain-shop-android-app/app/src/main/java/com/ainshop/app/. 'ios' says how the iPhone gets it — almost always 'website, no wrapper change', because the wrapper opens the website. 'status' is built (in the code), built-android (only on Android so far), or built-with-drift (built, with a known mismatch to fix). Nothing here is live until it is deployed — see UPDATE-FLOW.md.
